description.value: Royal Wok is a Chinese food and sushi restaurant in Salmon Arm, situated directly on the Trans-Canada Highway. The kitchen prides itself on sourcing fresh ingredients from local farmers' markets, and a chef with 20 years of fine-dining experience leads the menu. The restaurant offers dine-in buffet alongside takeout and delivery, and can accommodate private events ranging from weddings to business luncheons.

address.value: 141 Trans-Canada HWY NE, Salmon Arm, BC V1E 4H7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Royal Wok is a Chinese food and sushi restaurant in Salmon Arm at 141 Trans-Canada HWY NE — not a pub as OSM tags it. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('Now offering takeout and delivery'; 'Takeout, Delivery & Buffet'), but no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site, leaving those fields null. Phone numbers are confirmed from the website; the OSM address street and number match the website, though OSM omits city and postal code.
